basic_profile.bio: A seasoned Dota 2 enthusiast who has been following the game since its early days. I enjoy analyzing game patches and discussing strategies with fellow gamers. Based in Toronto, Canada, I work as a software developer by day, and in my free time, I delve into the world of competitive gaming. I'm an avid follower of speedrunning and occasionally dabble in puzzle-solving. Often online during late evenings and weekends, I'm single, which gives me more time to dedicate to my hobbies.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a deep understanding of Dota 2 mechanics and meta through years of playing and following professional games. My knowledge is largely self-taught, supplemented by watching professional streams and reading patch notes religiously.
